summary: Nathan's Famous filed an 8-K updating its pending merger with Smithfield Foods, announced January 20, 2026, under which Boardwalk Merger Sub will merge into the Company, leaving it a wholly owned Smithfield subsidiary and ending its NASDAQ listing. A definitive proxy was filed September 24, 2026. Two purported-stockholder suits filed September 30, 2026 in New York Supreme Court, plus fifteen demand letters, allege the proxy omitted material information and seek to enjoin or rescind the merger or recover damages. Watch disclosure-settlement risk and any special-meeting adjournment.
